title: Technical drawing of a part (PDF + DXF)
description: Draws a dimensioned sheet from a drawing spec: FreeCAD projects the views, the template lays them out so nothing overlaps (front, side, section, isometric, a detail), CADCraft draws real dimensions, a title block and notes. Write the spec first (skills/technical-drawing says what goes in it).

params.name: spec
params.description: The drawing spec, a JSON file (one part, or { "sheets": [...] } for several).

steps.note: Prints a report: the PDF, the scale, the views placed, anything left out and any warning.
